ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Module File Created
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a new PowerShell module ".psm1", ".psd1", ".dll", ".ps1", etc.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\Modules\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\\\Modules\\\\.*")))
